GlobalFoundries customer concentration risk disclosure largest customers

findings.claim: FY2024 20-F：兩個匿名客戶各超過營收 10%，Customer A 2024 年占 16%（$1,061M）、Customer B 占 11%（$722M）；客戶名稱未揭露。
findings.excerpt: Customer A accounted for $1,061 million, or 16%, in 2024, and Customer B $722 million, or 11%.

findings.claim: FY2021 20-F：前十大客戶占晶圓出貨量 2019/2020/2021 年約 73%/73%/67%；公司預期營收仍將集中在少數客戶。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers in 2019, 2020 and 2021 accounted for approximately 73%, 73% and 67% of our wafer shipment volume, respectively.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 僅 2 次搜尋；兩份揭露皆為舊年度（FY2024 20-F 為最新搜到，無 2025/2026 年度數字）。FY2023 與 FY2024 表中 Customer A/B 標籤疑似互換，未核對原檔。客戶本身信用/財務惡化（降評、財測下修）未查，記 none。
